controls.label: TEMPEST shape
controls.description: Numerical Dinkinesh shape distributed with the TEMPEST thermal model: 635 vertices and 1,266 triangles, retained at their published metre scale. The linked study describes a Lucy stereo-derived model with estimated unseen terrain. This recovered file does not identify its upstream mission-model version or observed/fill boundary. The grid marks missing qualified photography; it does not mark measured terrain.
controls.title: Dinkinesh model used by TEMPEST

controls.label: Celestia model
controls.description: Celestia contributors’ reconstruction inspired by Lucy images, uniformly scaled to the published 738 m volume-equivalent diameter. This is an authored approximation, not the mission photogrammetric shape model. The grid marks missing qualified surface imagery.
controls.title: Lucy encounter reconstruction
